subject: Follow-up: schedule demo/technical deep dive + security & procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@finpath.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up + proposed deep dive slots

Hi Alice,

Great chat today — appreciate the context on reconciliation latency and regulatory constraints. Next step: a 60–90 minute technical deep dive (SE + CS) to walk architecture, security, and pilot scope. Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 11/24, 9:00–10:30am
- Tue 11/24, 2:00–3:30pm
- Wed 11/25, 10:00–11:30am

Can you confirm which works for you and whether Tom/Lydia should be looped in? Attaching SOC 2 + a short network whitelist guide and draft SLA for procurement to skim ahead of time.

Agenda (proposed): 1) infra & traffic model, 2) latency/cost options (quantization, batching), 3) security controls & audit logs, 4) pilot success criteria.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2_Report_Redwood_v3.pdf, Network_Whitelist_Guide.pdf, SLA_Draft_Redwood_FP.docx

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finpath.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@finpath.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + proposed deep dive slots

Thanks Marissa — looping Tom (procurement) and Lydia (security). Tue 11/24 9:00–10:30am PT is best for our team. Two asks before the call if possible:
1) Can you send a one-page pricing band for a 3-month pilot (committed capacity + burst)? Procurement wants a ballpark to triage approvals.
2) Any network/IP whitelist ranges and KMS integration notes for our infra team to review.

I'll accept the invite once confirmed.

— Alice
VP Product, FinPath

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@finpath.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finpath.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@finpath.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + proposed deep dive slots

Confirmed: Tue 11/24, 9:00–10:30am PT. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-finpath-demo

Dev — can you prepare a short deck covering: prefix/KV cache model, batching for expected QPS, and network/TLS/KMS requirements. Monica — you'll own pilot scope & evaluation plan. Rishi — I'll bring draft SLA talking points for procurement.

Tom/Lydia — attaching SOC2, network whitelist guide, and a short pricing band doc (high-level ranges only). If there are specific contract items (billing cadence, uptime targets, liability) please flag before the call so Rishi can address them.

Thanks — we'll keep this tight and demo the most relevant latency/cost tradeoffs.

Marissa

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@finpath.com>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@finpath.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + proposed deep dive slots

Accepted the invite — thanks. We'll have procurement and security on the call. For procurement, the one-page pricing band was helpful; we'll follow up with any questions after the session. Looking forward to the walkthrough.

— Tom Nguyen
Head of Procurement, FinPath
